d:
Reset your nervous system and find immediate relief from stress with this 528 Hz healing frequency music. This track uses psychoactive soundscapes and the "Miracle Tone" of 528 Hz to help you transition from a state of fight-or-flight to deep, restorative peace.
Whether you are dealing with a hectic day, chronic overthinking, or physical tension, these gentle meditative sounds are designed to quiet the mind and harmonize your body's energy. Allow the healing vibrations to wash over you, clearing away negativity and restoring your inner balance.
